content.comment_body: I was wondering if anyone could help. I want to manually stop the program, but I can't select the option to stop writing above the settings, since it's not visible. I can configure it from the PC, but even then, the IP address can't be changed. Thanks.

If you don't see the 'Stop' entry in the system menu, it's because you're in user mode. In user mode, only a limited system menu is available. To stop the [product_name] manually, you need to be in admin mode. The default password for switching modes (unless changed) is '[product_name]'. Your topic title is in English, your comment is in Hungarian, and you're posting in the German language section of the forum.
